programme.title: The Very Best of Peter Sellers
programme.desc: A celebration of Peter Sellers' remarkable career, featuring some of the beloved comedian and actor's most iconic roles and unforgettable performances.

programme.title: Christopher Nolan: The Directors
programme.desc: Christopher Nolan: An iconic director with a portfolio of blockbuster films, explore the life and career of silver-screen genius Christopher Nolan. (S7, ep 6)

programme.title: Catching Fire: The Story Of Anita Pallenberg
programme.desc: This intimate documentary reveals the story of a fierce rock 'n' roller, actress, muse and mother who rose to prominence in the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Blue Road: The Edna O'Brien Story
programme.desc: Edna O'Brien, 93, reflects on her life, novels and love through journals read by Jessie Buckley, with insight from writers like Gabriel Byrne.

programme.title: Rolling Stone: Stories From The Edge
programme.desc: This eye-opening series takes an inside look at Rolling Stone magazine's cultural impact over the last 50 years. Contains nudity and adult themes. (1 of 6)

programme.title: The Sixties
programme.desc: The Times They Are A-Changin': A look at the changing social landscape of America in the 60s, from growing environmental concerns to civil rights and the women's movement. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: Classic FM Live: Classical Anthems
programme.desc: Alexander Armstrong and Myleene Klass present a concert of classical anthems at the Royal Albert Hall, with performances from Freddie De Tommaso, Hayato Sumino and more.

programme.title: The Joy Of Painting
programme.desc: Mountain Oval: Guest painter Steve Ross creates an oval landscape, featuring blue skies, a frosty mountain, fresh foothills and glistening lake. (S10, ep 9)

programme.title: The Joy Of Painting
programme.desc: Ocean Sunset: Bob paints a breathtaking seascape with a sunset sky and cascading waves, which combine to create a spectacular beach reflection. (S10, ep 10)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Fat Chance: A pharmacist tries to elope with his lover, but his larger than life wife stands in his way. John Castle and Miriam Margolyes star in this tale with a twist. (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Back For Christmas: A philandering physician with an obsession for orchids cultivates a deadly plot to see off his wife. Siân Phillips and Richard Johnson star. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Bull in a China Shop: A homicide detective is befriended by four old women who invite him for tea and proceed to play out a variation of Arsenic and Old Lace for his benefit. (S3, ep 26)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Disappearing Trick: A bookmaker blackmails a man who feigned death to collect insurance money, and finds the man's wife wants a share. (S3, ep 27)

programme.title: Discovering: Peter Ustinov
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the two-time Academy Award-winning star of Spartacus, Topkapi, Quo Vadis and more. (S13, ep 5)

programme.title: Discovering: Paul Simon
programme.desc: Leading music critics cast fresh light on the career of award-winning American singer songwriter Paul Simon, whose fame, influence and success began as part of duo Simon & Garfunkel.

programme.title: Discovering: Meat Loaf
programme.desc: Music journalists examine the life and music of the late Meat Loaf, the legendary singer-songwriter behind Bat Out of Hell. (S5, ep 4)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Picture Of A Place: Hazel is an elderly widow who lives in a farmhouse full of antiques. When a conman arrives he dupes her into selling him a picture at a knock-down price. (S3, ep 2)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Proof Of Guilt: George is denying murder, even though he was in a locked room with the victim when he was shot. Inspector Walters just can't find any evidence against him. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Lamb to the Slaughter: When Mary Maloney's police chief husband is found dead, the police investigate and run into difficulties trying to find the murder weapon. (S3, ep 28)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Fatal Figures: A meek bored man wants to feel a sense of importance, so he turns to serious crimes ranging from theft to eventual murder. (S3, ep 29)

programme.title: The Sixties
programme.desc: Sex, Drugs and Rock and Roll: A look at America's changing morality during the 60s, from views towards sex and the use of drugs to a newfound expressiveness through music. (S1, ep 10)

programme.title: Discovering: Ian McKellen
programme.desc: A glimpse into the life and six-decade long career of Sir Ian McKellen, star of Richard III and X-Men, who has won many awards for his vast work in film. (S13, ep 6)

programme.title: Landscape Artist Of The Year
programme.desc: The last of the heats takes place in Worm's Head, Wales, where the artists have just four hours to capture the stunning coastal scene on canvas. (6 of 9)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Vengeance Is Mine Inc: Mrs Wilbur gets more than she bargained for when she calls upon the services of Tom and George, two actors from New York who are hell bent on revenge. (S3, ep 4)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: A Girl Can't Always Have Everything: Struggling actresses Suzy and Pat meet Herbert, a wealthy widower. Seductive Suzy enjoys his money, but things soon don't look so rosy. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
programme.desc: To Catch a Butterfly: When a young couple moves into a new neighborhood, they find their lives and marriage threatened by the boy next door. (S1, ep 19)

programme.title: Guy Garvey: From The Vaults
programme.desc: 1978 Revisited: Guy returns to 1978, where the punk revolution is still alive with bands like The Undertones and Sex Pistols. Features interviews with The Fall and Magazine. (S4, ep 1)

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix: Blue Wild Angel
programme.desc: Live At The Isle Of Wight. New: Witness Jimi Hendrix's electrifying final UK performance at the Isle of Wight Festival, captured just weeks before his untimely death.

programme.title: New: Message to Love: The Isle of Wight Festival
programme.desc: New. Music, idealism and chaos collide at the 1970 Isle of Wight Festival, as The Who, The Doors and Jimi Hendrix perform against a backdrop of turmoil.

programme.title: Isle of Wight Festival 2025: James
programme.desc: Coverage of the iconic Isle of Wight festival, one of the UK's biggest and most legendary highlights of the summer. Featuring James.

programme.title: Rolling Stone: Stories From The Edge
programme.desc: Exploring the unique relationship between John Lennon and the magazine, and how coverage of Nixon's re-election campaign disrupted political journalism. (2 of 6)

programme.title: The Sixties
programme.desc: Sex, Drugs and Rock and Roll: A look at America's changing morality during the 60s, from views towards sex and the use of drugs to a newfound expressiveness through music. (S1, ep 10)

programme.title: The Wind In The Willows
programme.desc: Join Ratty, Badger, Mole and the impulsive Toad as they embark on a series of riotous adventures spiralling from Toad's insatiable need for speed.

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Mr Botibol's First Love: Jake Weston stars in this twisted story. A jaded businessman sells his company and attempts to change his life for the better by buying a strange piano. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Umbrella Man: John Mills stars in this story with a twist. A con man arrives in town and starts his scam. Michael Gambon guest stars. (S2, ep 9)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Flypaper: Lorna Charles and Alfred Burke star in this twisted tale. With a 12 year-old found dead and a killer perhaps on the loose, a young girl becomes paranoid. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Orderly World of Mr Appleby: Robert Lang stars in this tale with a twist. A man married three times might be lucky for the fourth time when he meets a new interest. (S2, ep 11)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Fat Chance: A pharmacist tries to elope with his lover, but his larger than life wife stands in his way. John Castle and Miriam Margolyes star in this tale with a twist. (S2, ep 12)

programme.desc: Le Poulet (The Chicken). 1965. A child becomes attached to a chicken. To stop his parents from eating it, he places an egg near the animal every morning, making it seem like a hen.

programme.title: My Cousin Rachel (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Mystery. Directed by Henry Koster. Stars Olivia de Havilland, Richard Burton & Audrey Dalton. The heir to a considerable fortune attempts to find out if the woman he loves is a murderess.

programme.title: Hobson's Choice
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Charles Laughton, John Mills & Brenda de Banzie. Henry Hobson's three daughters want to marry, but he refuses as traditions require him to pay settlements.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Muriel and Sally Pt1. Stars: Vivienne Burgess, Tessa Wyatt and Lindsay Ingram. Two people who are widely separated by personality and character are brought together by just one factor...

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Muriel and Sally Pt2. Stars: Vivienne Burgess, Tessa Wyatt and Lindsay Ingram. After listening to Muriel's story, it is now Sally's turn to tell hers.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Trammel Nets/Coach Builder. 1986. Two more excerpts from Jack Hargreaves's archive as he goes inshore fishing with a three-tiered net and visits a factory that makes wooden cart wheels.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Whipping Boy. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Christopher Benjamin & David Daker. The rivalry between the Captain & the Colonel rears up again, leaving Spiker demoted and Moat imposing terror.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Rich Man, Poor Man. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. An explosion almost kills a worker at a factory, and a poor immigrant barber is beaten to death in a luxury apartment.

programme.title: Modesty Blaise
programme.desc: 1966. Action. Director: Joseph Losey. Stars Monica Vitti, Dirk Bogarde & Terrence Stamp. A spy spoof in the 60s tradition with comic book heroine, Modesty Blaise. Set in the Italian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Christopher Biggins, Lindy Benson. Plumber's mate Sid meets ladies at work. Susie is unaware of his dalliances as he gets into debt trouble.

programme.title: Meet Mr Callaghan
programme.desc: 1954. Crime drama directed by Charles Saunders. Private detective Slim Callaghan (Derrick De Marney) is hired to find out why a rich uncle changed his will.

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: A Barrel Full Of Moneys. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Swindler. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Spell of Tut. 1966. Stars Adam West, Victor Buono & Marianna Hill. Batman and Robin battle the nefarious King Tut who plots to take over Gotham City with an ancient potion.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Tut's Case is Shut. 1966. Stars Adam West, Marianna Hill, Sid Haig. Robin reveals that Gordon's secretary, Miss Cleo Patrick, is working for Tut and plans to slip the Commissioner a scarab mickey.

programme.title: The Rossiter Case
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Directed by Francis Searle. Stars Helen Shingler, Clement McCallin & Sheila Burrell. After an accident results in her paralysis, a woman fears that her husband will abandon her.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Sydney Chaplin, Audrey Dalton & Jefferson Clifford. After several killings of thieves occur, a priest is then marked for murder after hearing a confession.

programme.title: Three Sundays to Live
programme.desc: 1957. Mystery. Director: Ernest Morris. Stars Kieron Moore, Jane Griffiths & Basil Dignam. Frank Martin is accused of murder and the only woman who can prove his innocence is missing.

programme.title: Men In War
programme.desc: 1957. War. Director: Anthony Mann. Stars Robert Ryan, Robert Keith, Aldo Ray & Vic Morrow. During the Korean War, Lt. Benson and his troops find a colonel experiencing psychological combat trauma.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. The White Cliffs Mystery. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, Yvonne Andre and Peter Bathurst. A dead rocket engineer was being blackmailed. But why - and by whom? (S1, E25)

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: A Matter of Honour. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Michael Culver. Charlie is shocked to find that one of his best friends, Lord Elleston, arranged for his horse to lose at Ascot.

programme.title: Interrupted Journey
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Director: Daniel Birt. Stars Valerie Hobson, Richard Todd, Christine Norden & Tom Walls. John's wife appears to have been shot after her body is found in the wreckage of a crash.

programme.title: Look At Life High, Wide and Faster
programme.desc: 1963. A captivating look at the plans for closer co-ordination between our roads, railways and coastal shipping.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: Noel looks at Scrooge - the first full length sound version of the story, directed by Hagen's closest collaborator Henry Edwards and the first film distributed by Twickenham Film Distributors.

programme.title: Scrooge
programme.desc: 1935. Family. Ebenezer Scrooge (Seymour Hicks) is persuaded to change his ways one Christmas by visitations from the ghosts of Christmas past, present and yet-to-come. Also stars Donald Calthrop.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: After a wonderful afternoon viewing of Scrooge, Noel wraps up the season of Julius Hagen with a glimpse into Hagen's later life and career.

programme.title: Weir's Way
programme.desc: Berwick Upon Tweed. 1980. Tom Weir explores the delights of a town, and an English one at that. Celebrating its 500th year under English rule, Berwick-Upon-Tweed had previously been Scottish.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Saturday. 1974. Stars Jennifer Wilson, Jean Anderson & Sean Caffrey. Hammond Transport faces strike action again. Meanwhile, Ted and Brian take Mary on a picnic, where they retreat into the past.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Saber's Bow and Arrow. 1959. Stars Donald Gray, Neil McCallum, Ann Stephens & Michael Bryant. A wealthy man asks Mark Saber to find his eloping daughter, but she has been kidnapped.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 24. 1975. Gene Pitney performs 'Half Heaven Half Heartache' and 'Blue Angel'. Plus, there's performances from Paul Daniels, Royal Polynesian Revue and Rivendell.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's Melissa
programme.desc: Part 1. 1974. Stars Peter Barkworth, Ronald Fraser & Joan Benham. Guy Foster refuses to accompany his wife Melissa to a party, only to find that he has been implicated in her murder.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's Melissa
programme.desc: Part 2. 1974. Stars Peter Barkworth, Ronald Fraiser & Moira Redmond. Guy Foster is implicated in the death of Mary & the attack on Joyce. Inspector Carter is struggling to believe Guy's story.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's Melissa
programme.desc: Part 3. 1974. Stars Peter Barkworth, Ronald Fraiser & Joan Benham. Guy Foster sets a trap for the killer, talk of a tape recording draws the whole truth out.
